changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Metadatos de la foto adjunta de la incidencia (ARC-114, REQ-091): como maximo un adjunto por incidencia, clave opaca y checksum SHA-256
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE incidencia_adjunto ( attachment_id NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, incident_id NUMBER NOT NULL, file_name VARCHAR2(255 CHAR) NOT NULL, mime_type VARCHAR2(50 CHAR) NOT NULL, file_size_bytes NUMBER NOT NULL, file_checksum CHAR(64) NOT NULL, storage_key VARCHAR2(255 CHAR) NOT NULL, uploaded_by NUMBER NOT NULL, uploaded_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, stored_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP), uploaded_by_user_id GENERATED ALWAYS AS (uploaded_by) VIRTUAL, CONSTRAINT pk_incidencia_adjunto PRIMARY KEY (attachment_id), CONSTRAINT uk_incidencia_adjunto_incident UNIQUE (incident_id), CONSTRAINT uk_incidencia_adjunto_storage_key UNIQUE (storage_key), CONSTRAINT fk_incidencia_adjunto_incident FOREIGN KEY (incident_id) REFERENCES incidencia (incident_id), CONSTRAINT fk_incidencia_adjunto_uploaded_by FOREIGN KEY (uploaded_by) REFERENCES usuario (user_id) )

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Reglas del adjunto (AC-INC-06, AC-RET-07): whitelist de mime, limite de 5 MB, checksum SHA-256 hexadecimal y clave de almacen opaca
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE incidencia_adjunto ADD CONSTRAINT ck_inc_adj_mime_type CHECK (mime_type IN ('image/jpeg','image/png'))
ALTER TABLE incidencia_adjunto ADD CONSTRAINT ck_inc_adj_file_size_max CHECK (file_size_bytes <= 5242880)
ALTER TABLE incidencia_adjunto ADD CONSTRAINT ck_inc_adj_file_size_min CHECK (file_size_bytes > 0)
ALTER TABLE incidencia_adjunto ADD CONSTRAINT ck_inc_adj_checksum_hex CHECK (REGEXP_LIKE(file_checksum, '^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$'))
ALTER TABLE incidencia_adjunto ADD CONSTRAINT ck_inc_adj_storage_key_len CHECK (LENGTH(storage_key) >= 32)
ALTER TABLE incidencia_adjunto ADD CONSTRAINT ck_inc_adj_storage_key_opaca CHECK (NOT REGEXP_LIKE(storage_key, '^[0-9]+$'))
ALTER TABLE incidencia_adjunto ADD CONSTRAINT ck_inc_adj_file_name_blank CHECK (TRIM(file_name) IS NOT NULL)
ALTER TABLE incidencia_adjunto ADD CONSTRAINT ck_inc_adj_file_name_sane CHECK (INSTR(file_name, '/') = 0 AND INSTR(file_name, '\') = 0 AND INSTR(file_name, '..') = 0)

ALTER TABLE incidencia_adjunto ADD CONSTRAINT ck_inc_adj_file_name_ext CHECK ((mime_type = 'image/jpeg' AND (LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.jpg' OR LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.jpeg')) OR (mime_type = 'image/png' AND LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.png'))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE incidencia_adjunto DROP CONSTRAINT ck_inc_adj_file_name_ext
ALTER TABLE incidencia_adjunto DROP CONSTRAINT ck_inc_adj_file_name_sane
ALTER TABLE incidencia_adjunto DROP CONSTRAINT ck_inc_adj_file_name_blank
ALTER TABLE incidencia_adjunto DROP CONSTRAINT ck_inc_adj_storage_key_opaca
ALTER TABLE incidencia_adjunto DROP CONSTRAINT ck_inc_adj_storage_key_len
ALTER TABLE incidencia_adjunto DROP CONSTRAINT ck_inc_adj_checksum_hex
ALTER TABLE incidencia_adjunto DROP CONSTRAINT ck_inc_adj_file_size_min
ALTER TABLE incidencia_adjunto DROP CONSTRAINT ck_inc_adj_file_size_max
ALTER TABLE incidencia_adjunto DROP CONSTRAINT ck_inc_adj_mime_type
